panels.description:
node local storage like ext4, xfs
excluding tmpfs & fuse.lxcfs

targets.expr:
( sum without (device) ( max without () (
      node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", nodename=~".*", fstype="tmpfs"} 
    - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", nodename=~".*", fstype="tmpfs"}  )) 
/ ignoring (instance) group_left sum without (instance, device) ( max without () (
      node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", nodename=~".*", fstype="tmpfs"}  )))

( sum without (device) ( max without () (
      node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", nodename=~".*", fstype="fuse.lxcfs"} 
    - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", nodename=~".*", fstype="fuse.lxcfs"}  )) 
/ ignoring (instance) group_left sum without (instance, device) ( max without () (
      node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", nodename=~".*", fstype="fuse.lxcfs"}  )))

targets.expr: ( 100 * (sum by(pod,container) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubelet", container!~"POD|$Hidden", node=~"$Node", image!=""}[4m])) / sum by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="cpu", node=~"$Node", container!~"$Hidden"}) ))

panels.title: % CPU use / lim

targets.expr: ( 100 * (sum by(pod,container) (container_memory_usage_bytes{job="kubelet", node=~"$Node", container!~"POD|$Hidden"}) / sum by(pod,container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="kube-state-metrics", resource="memory", node=~"$Node", container!~"$Hidden" }) ))

100 *
(
